evidence: Manual API forms and authored offline tests; no native I/O, task or teach-pendant execution

sources.topic: Logical port comments, GET/SET_PORT_VAL and GET/SET_PORT_SIM; codes delegated to KLIOTYPS include
Numeric, position and string register comment procedure forms; numeric comment truncation at 16 characters
GET_TPE_PRM argument order, maximum ten arguments, type codes 1/2/3 and missing status 17042

implemented.indirect_ports: Caller-supplied INTEGER code-to-kind mapping, shared existing PortBank storage and explicit missing/range/representation/direction statuses
implemented.simulation: SET_PORT_SIM initializes the logical value and marks it simulated; SET_PORT_VAL permits outputs and simulated inputs; direct source input assignments remain rejected
implemented.port_comments: Independent 16-character ASCII metadata; empty comment is available before a value exists
implemented.register_comments: Independent numeric/position/string bank comments with capacities 16/16/254; setter/destination truncation; valid empty default and range status 2
implemented.parameters: CallParameters selects root-task arguments 1..10; type 1 INTEGER, 2 REAL, 3 STRING; unused outputs preserved; absent argument writes only status 17042
implemented.persistence: Optional metadata and parameters preserved through context JSON; numeric-register standalone to_config includes comments; legacy shapes retained when metadata is empty

portable_choices: No default port type-code enum is inferred; source numeric codes must match the caller-supplied mapping
GET_PORT_VAL manual parameter line lists STRING while Boolean details describe 0/1; runtime supports INTEGER/REAL/BOOLEAN/STRING scalar outputs and setters
GET_PORT_SIM uses the documented INTEGER output with 0/1 despite prose describing TRUE/FALSE
Fractional analog-to-INTEGER conversion returns representation status 3; no implicit truncation
Port statuses 0/1/2/3/4 are explicit offline conventions without native alarm mapping
Port comment setters truncate to 16 where the manual requires at most 16; position comment capacity 16 and string comment capacity 254 are portable choices
Comments do not initialize registers and position comments are shared across bank groups
GET_TPE_PRM unused outputs remain untouched; STRING results truncate to destination capacity
Arguments are supplied per root program by the host, persist across runs and are not forwarded by source RUN_TASK
remaining: Native type-code include loading, physical port assignments, reverse/complementary modes, unsimulation and hardware acquisition
Native register-comment limits/alarms beyond the documented numeric truncation
Teach-pendant program loading/execution, native CALL/MACRO acquisition and task ABI
